name: Subby's Plushies & Essentials
notes: Consolidates the V4 Heartkeeper radiating Halo-style bloom, centered native layer and handheld Light up/Extinguish toggle.
Preserves the nine original lantern colors and the tenth colorable Glow row, its priority 24 and other lantern layers at 25.
Unifies native asset labels and LayerNames.csv cache repair for both the Fallen Seraph Rose and Heartkeeper Lantern.
Expands localized text-cache path detection and refreshes labels when either custom item color editor is opened.
Retains R133 page-two safety code and fixes missing/incomplete color arrays without overwriting valid existing colors.
Removes duplicate embedded Glow sprites; one PNG supplies the native glow mask.
Source and asset consistency tested locally; requires live R133 validation for UI rendering and third-party mod interactions.
